Main issues were: (1) Metric variants needed consolidation into base forms, (2) Question 3 metadata was incorrectly included since the paper doesn't use LLMs as judges (only for automatic metrics), (3) Some datasets mentioned in comparisons were missing. The paper focuses on dialogue summarization evaluation with comprehensive automatic and human evaluation.
